props.gloss_en: once they forgot and did not bring the scalpel before Shabbat, and they brought it on Shabbat by way of roofs and by way of courtyards
[this was] against the wishes of R' Eliezer
the mishna, R' Eliezer: if one did not bring the implement before Shabbat, he brings it on Shabbat, uncovered
(entertained) it was according to the Rabbis, who forbid by way of the public domain and permit by way of roofs, courtyards and enclosures
the baraita: just as one may not bring it by way of the public domain, so one may not bring it by way of roofs, enclosures or courtyards
Rav Ashi: against the wishes of R' Eliezer and of his disputants, but according to R' Shimon
R' Shimon: roofs, enclosures and courtyards are all one domain for vessels that rested inside them, and not for vessels that rested inside the house
in an alley whose residents did not merge, one may carry throughout it
(dilemma, side 1) it is like a courtyard: as in a courtyard one may carry throughout though they did not make an eruv, so here
(dilemma, side 2) it is unlike a courtyard: a courtyard has four partitions and this has not
(dilemma, side 2, alternative ground) a courtyard has residents and this has none
once they forgot and did not bring the scalpel before Shabbat, and they brought it on Shabbat
for one thing, R' Eliezer is a Shammuti
and further: [in a dispute of] an individual and the many, the halakha follows the many
R' Yehuda the circumciser: it was an alley whose residents had not merged, and they brought it from this end to that end
in the flow [of study] my learning ran back to me
Rav (via R' Zeira): in an alley whose residents did not merge, one carries only within four cubits
Abaye: R' Zeira said this and did not explain it, until Rabba bar Avuh came and explained it -- Rav's four cubits is the case where the courtyards merged with the houses
Rav (via Rabba bar Avuh): an unmerged alley where the courtyards merged with the houses -- one carries only within four cubits
where the courtyards did not merge with the houses -- one may carry throughout it
(Rav Chanina Choza'a, as a question) what is different where they merged courtyards with houses? that the courtyards were detached and became houses
Rav: an alley is not permitted by a sidepost and a crossbeam unless houses and courtyards open into it
(entertained) where they did not merge, it is possible for all to renounce their domain to one
(entertained) it is possible [to renounce] from morning to midday to one, and from midday to evening to another
Rav Ashi: what caused the courtyards to be forbidden? the houses -- and there are none
R' Yochanan: not for every [mitzva] did R' Eliezer say that the facilitators of a mitzva override Shabbat
for the two loaves are the obligation of the day
and R' Eliezer learned them only from a gezera shava
R' Eliezer: the facilitators of the two loaves override Shabbat
R' Eliezer: as for the bringing stated of the omer, its facilitators override Shabbat
the omer-side token is free: 'and you shall bring the omer' is already written, so why 'from the day you brought'? conclude it is there to be free
R' Eliezer: [a gezera shava] free on one side only -- one learns from it and one refutes it
'you shall bring' [of the two loaves] is an extra word -- free on that side too
(entertained) R' Yochanan's 'not for every' excludes lulav: its facilitators do not override Shabbat
(entertained) it excludes sukka
(entertained) it excludes matza
(entertained) it excludes shofar
the baraita: lulav and all its facilitators override Shabbat -- R' Eliezer
the baraita: sukka and all its facilitators override Shabbat -- R' Eliezer
the baraita: matza and all its facilitators override Shabbat -- R' Eliezer
the baraita: shofar and all its facilitators override Shabbat -- R' Eliezer
Rav Adda bar Ahava: it excludes tzitzit for his garment and a mezuza for his doorway -- their facilitators do not override Shabbat
the baraita: and they agree that if one put tzitzit on his garment or made a mezuza for his doorway [on Shabbat] he is liable
Rav Yosef: because they have no fixed time
since it is in his power to render them ownerless

grounds.gloss_en: מופני, דאי לא מופני איכא למיפרך: מה לעומר שכן אם מצא קצור קוצר, תאמר בשתי הלחם שאם מצא קצור אינו קוצר -- the refutation that would hold were the words not free

answered_by.gloss_en: לאיי, אפנויי מופני: מיום הביאכם למה לי? שמע מינה לאפנויי (= p_mufneh_omer)

grounds.gloss_en: ואכתי מופנה מצד אחד הוא, ושמעינן ליה לרבי אליעזר דאמר מופנה מצד אחד למידין ומשיבין -- still free on one side only, and for R' Eliezer such a GS can be refuted (p_re_mitzad_echad_meshivin)

answered_by.gloss_en: תביאו ריבויא הוא -- the two-loaves side is free as well (= p_mufneh_shtei_halechem)

questions.gloss_en: R' Zeira asked R' Asi: an alley whose residents did not merge -- may one carry throughout it? R' Asi was silent and said nothing to him (he answers 'yes' at 130b.6: p_mavoi_mutar_bekhulo)

supports.gloss_en: דתנן, רבי שמעון אומר: אחד גגות ואחד קרפיפות ואחד חצירות -- כולן רשות אחד הן לכלים ששבתו בתוכן
ורב לטעמיה, דאמר רב: אין המבוי ניתר בלחי וקורה עד שיהו בתים וחצרות פתוחין לתוכו -- and here there are houses but no courtyards
שהרי שתי הלחם חובת היום הן, ולא למדן רבי אליעזר אלא מגזירה שוה
דתניא, רבי אליעזר אומר: מניין למכשירי שתי הלחם שדוחין את השבת? נאמרה הבאה בעומר ונאמרה הבאה בשתי הלחם
תניא נמי הכי: ושוין שאם צייץ טליתו ועשה מזוזה לפתחו שהוא חייב

frames.gloss_en: למעוטי מאי? -- which mitzva does R' Yochanan's 'not for every' exclude?

והתניא: סוכה וכל מכשיריה דוחין את השבת, דברי רבי אליעזר (= p_b_sukka)

alternatives.gloss_en: the survivor: Rav Adda bar Ahava, tzitzit and mezuza (131a.8), supported by תניא נמי הכי

objections.gloss_en: מתקיף לה רב יוסף: שלא ברצון רבי אליעזר?! אדרבה, רבי אליעזר הוא דשרי -- on the contrary, R' Eliezer is the one who permits

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אמר רב אשי: שלא ברצון רבי אליעזר ומחלוקתו, אלא ברצון רבי שמעון (= p_rav_ashi_kirtzon_rs)

objections.gloss_en: ומי שרו? והתניא: כשם שאין מביאין אותו דרך רשות הרבים, כך אין מביאין אותו לא דרך גגות ולא דרך קרפיפות ולא דרך חצירות
והיה הדבר קשה לחכמים: היאך מניחין דברי חכמים ועושין כרבי אליעזר -- (the stam: R' Eliezer is a Shammuti, p_re_shamuti; and an individual against the many)

answered_by.gloss_en: ואמר רבי אושעיא: שאילית את רבי יהודה הגוזר ואמר לי: מבוי שלא נשתתפו בו הוה, ואייתוהו מהאי רישא להאי רישא (= p_rhg_mavoi)

objections.gloss_en: והא זימנין בעאי מינך ולא אמרת לי הכי -- but once I asked you and you did not tell me so

answered_by.gloss_en: אין, אגב שיטפא רהיט לי גמרי (= p_agav_shitfa)

objections.gloss_en: כי לא עירבו נמי, ליחזינהו להני בתים כמאן דסתימי דמו, וחצרות איכא ובתים ליכא -- when they did not merge too, regard the houses as sealed: there are courtyards but no houses

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא אמר רב אשי: מי גרם לחצרות שיאסרו -- בתים, וליכא (= p_rav_ashi_mi_garam); the two אפשר answers before it fell (h_bitul_lechad, h_chalukat_yom)

objections.gloss_en: אדרבה, מדאין קבוע להם זמן, כל שעתא ושעתא זמניה הוא -- on the contrary: since they have no fixed time, every moment is their time (continues at 131b.1)
